public_rationale: Primary announcements confirm Anthropic's cloud relationships with Amazon and Google. They do not establish the specific annual guarantees. limitations: The claim relies on an unnamed source whose underlying records are unavailable.
Aggregate spending commitments and annual revenue guarantees are different measures.
